description: Which Kalshi and Polymarket weather series groundhog tracks (key, family, kind, city, station, product), which it sees at the venue but does not support and why, and when each venue was last read. The REST body of /api/v1/markets/coverage. No prices. A successful result also carries structuredContent: the format=json body (outputSchema).

fields.description: full (default) | compact: leave out null members of the JSON (structuredContent and format=json)

name: coverage

credits.description: Credit strings to keep when you repeat numbers.

venue.description: Venue asked for, or null for both.

venues.description: Per venue (only the one asked for with venue=).

list_asof.description: When `unsupported` was taken (UTC): Kalshi = that file; Polymarket = the last open-listing pull. null = not counted yet.

note.description: How the lists are made, in words.

tracked.description: Every series groundhog tracks (markets rows come from these).

key.description: Series key (Kalshi ticker, a city ticker for multi-city series; Polymarket slug pattern).

kind.description: day | weekend | month | season | once | window | year.

status.description: active | rule_changed (values paused) | watch (shown once it lists an event).

unsupported.description: Weather series the venue lists that groundhog does not track.

event_url.description: A venue page for it (Polymarket: the newest event).

family.description: high | low | rain when known, else null.

first_seen.description: When groundhog first saw it (UTC); null when not known.

key.description: Kalshi ticker, or the Polymarket slug pattern (dates and numbers as <month>, <d>, <yyyy>, <n>).

kind.description: day | month | once | year ... when known, else null.

n.description: Polymarket: open events of the pattern in the listing; Kalshi: null.

reason.description: Why it is not tracked, e.g. 'snow: not a covered family', 'multi-day rain: not supported', 'unknown city'.

venue_asof.description: When groundhog last read this venue (UTC): Kalshi = the last imported Kalshi file (no Kalshi request since 10/29, CONTRACTS §33); Polymarket = the last good pull.
